title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Genesis 2: the seventh day, the garden in Eden, the first man and the first woman.

questions.text: On which day did God rest from his work?
questions.explanation: God finished his work on the sixth day and rested on the seventh. He blessed that day and made it holy.

questions.text: What did God form the man from?
questions.explanation: God formed the man from the dust of the ground, which is why Adam's name sounds like the Hebrew word for ground.

questions.text: What did God breathe into the man's nostrils?
questions.explanation: The man became a living soul when God breathed the breath of life into him.

questions.text: Where did God plant a garden?
questions.explanation: God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, and put the man he had formed there.

questions.text: Which two special trees stood in the middle of the garden?
questions.explanation: The tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil grew in the middle of the garden.

answers.text: The fig tree and the olive tree of the field
The tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil
The cedar tree and the palm tree of Eden
The vine and the pomegranate of the garden

questions.text: What did the man do with the animals God brought to him?
questions.explanation: The man gave names to all the livestock, the birds of the sky and every animal of the field.

questions.text: What was the man's task in the garden?
questions.explanation: God put the man in the garden to cultivate it and to keep it.

answers.text: To guard it with a sword
To build a wall around it

questions.text: Which tree was the man forbidden to eat from?
questions.explanation: God allowed the man to eat freely from every tree except the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

answers.text: The tree of life in the middle
The tree standing by the river
The tree of the knowledge of good and evil
Every single tree in the garden

questions.text: What did God say was not good?
questions.explanation: God saw that it was not good for the man to be alone, and said he would make a helper suitable for him.

answers.text: That the garden had no walls
That the man had no work
That the man should be alone

questions.text: How did God make the woman?
questions.explanation: God caused a deep sleep to fall on the man, took one of his ribs and made it into a woman.

answers.text: From the dust of the ground
From one of the man's ribs
From the water of the river
